policy.expiry: A record expires automatically when the corpus content digest changes, because evidence captured against different assertions does not describe the current ground truth. A harness or environment change cannot be detected from the corpus, so those records are retired explicitly with superseded_by.
policy.independence: reproduction_class records who produced the evidence. Maintainer and vendor evidence is reported as executed and, when reviewed, verified; only independent and academic reproduction is reported as independently verified.
